EPL 501: This course familiarizes students to three topics that prepare them for future coursework and doctoral research.
EPL 502: This course will familiarize students with the role of politics and public policy in K-12 and higher education.
EPL 503: This course will examine policy and programs in education and related institutions through the lens of diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging with the specific goal of building skills in ethical leadership.
EPL 504: This course introduces students to research design in the social sciences as it applies to education policy and leadership.
EPL 594: Supervised student activities on research projects identified on an individual or small-group basis.
EPL 595: Supervised, research-oriented, off-campus, nongroup instruction, including field experiences, practicums, or internships.
EPL 596: Creative projects, including nonthesis research, that are supervised on an individual basis and which fall outside the scope of formal courses.
EPL 597: Formal courses given on a topical or special interest subject which may be offered infrequently; several different topics may be taught in one year or semester.
EPL 602: Supervised experience in teaching and orientation to other selected aspects of the profession at The Pennsylvania State University.
